Missing Specificity and ROC/PR AUC in evaluation metrics

Root_Cause: Lack of systematic hyperparameter tuning on training partition
Impact: Suboptimal model discrimination and unverified hyperparameters
Remediation: Added GridSearchCV hyperparameter search strictly inside training folds

Root_Cause: Internal model boolean strings ('false') leaked into UI session state causing selectbox ValueError
Remediation: Decoupled UI form state from model inputs and added safe_get_option_index

Root_Cause: Indented HTML in markdown string parsed as raw code block
Impact: Unformatted HTML tags displayed instead of styled comparison table
Remediation: Stripped leading indentations and formatted flat HTML container

Root_Cause: Missing pytest rootdir pythonpath configuration causing ModuleNotFoundError
Impact: Direct pytest execution failed in CI/automation
Remediation: Added pytest.ini configuring pythonpath=. and testpaths=tests

Root_Cause: Pickle/joblib deserialization of local model pipelines
Impact: Tampering risk if local filesystem write access is compromised
Remediation: Restricted artifact directory and added metadata schema verification
Verification_Test: Static audit and metadata loading validation

Impact: Predictions cannot be used as medical diagnoses
Remediation: Enforced explicit clinical disclaimers and educational risk likelihood framing
